Selected Engineering Contributions

AI Agent Gateway & Large-Scale Traffic Scheduling
TRAE AI Infrastructure
  • Architected a centralized execution gateway for chat and agent workloads, separating product orchestration from model and provider details while preserving context, tool state, reasoning streams, usage, and terminal events end to end.
  • Built hierarchical routing from logical models to execution models and provider resources, combining capability matching, context length, region, real-time health, queue pressure, and capacity into scheduling decisions.
Failure Isolation & Graceful Recovery
Reliability Engineering
  • Normalized heterogeneous provider failures into retryable, degradable, and terminal categories; implemented timeout and retry budgets, exponential backoff, cross-model fallback, health-aware circuit breaking, and progressive recovery.
  • Combined admission control, priority queueing, backpressure, session affinity, and long-context isolation to absorb burst traffic, prevent retry amplification, and contain downstream failures.
Fine-Grained Prompt Cache Optimization
Latency & Cost
  • Unified explicit and implicit cache semantics and usage accounting across provider protocols; stabilized reusable prefixes through system-prompt discipline, append-only context construction, deterministic tool serialization, and cache-aware session routing.
  • Built diagnostics by model, provider, resource type, and deployment mode, correlating cache behavior with first-token latency, token usage, and request traces to identify structural misses and billing anomalies.
Unified Multi-Provider Model Runtime
Protocol & Adapter Layer
  • Defined canonical request, response, and streaming event contracts, with adapters that reconcile SSE lifecycles, tool calls, structured output, reasoning and thinking content, cache metadata, token usage, finish reasons, and errors.
  • Made capabilities and parameter translation configuration-driven, enabling rapid integration of domestic and international models without leaking provider-specific semantics into product and agent code.
Model Lifecycle & Day-0 Delivery Platform
Platform Engineering
  • Built lifecycle workflows for model and provider metadata, capability parameters, routing policies, connectivity checks, configuration diff, evaluation gates, staged rollout, rollback, and cross-environment synchronization.
  • Standardized model onboarding and release playbooks so product, evaluation, quality, infrastructure, and engineering teams can validate and launch new capabilities through one auditable path.
Observability, Diagnosis & Agent Governance
Production Operations
  • Established end-to-end metrics and traces across admission, queueing, routing, provider calls, first-token latency, streaming throughput, terminal status, usage, and cache behavior, with automated case-level diagnosis.
  • Implemented reasoning-effort propagation across clients, agent orchestration, gateway, and model mapping; contributed sandbox policies and capability boundaries to constrain execution risk and limit blast radius.
